import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import { useCart } from '../../context/CartContext'; import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext'; const Cart = () => { const { cartBatch, cartItems, cartSubtotal, updateQuantity, removeFromCart, clearCart, } = useCart(); const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth(); const navigate = useNavigate(); const [fulfillmentType, setFulfillmentType] = useState('PICKUP'); if (!cartBatch || cartItems.length === 0) { return (

); } const prepDate = new Date(cartBatch.preparationDate); const deadline = new Date(cartBatch.orderDeadline); const deliveryFee = fulfillmentType === 'DELIVERY' && cartBatch.deliveryAvailable ? Number(cartBatch.deliveryFee || 0) : 0; const totalAmount = cartSubtotal + deliveryFee; const handleProceedToCheckout = () => { if (!isAuthenticated) { navigate('/login', { state: { from: { pathname: '/checkout' } } }); } else { // Store chosen fulfillment type for checkout sessionStorage.setItem('bb_fulfillment', fulfillmentType); navigate('/checkout'); } }; return (

Review your reserved portions for {cartBatch.batchName}

{/* Batch Notice Banner */}
Batch Schedule
{cartBatch.batchName}
Prep Date: {prepDate.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })} Deadline: {deadline.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
Add More Items From This Batch
{/* Items List */}
Reserved Items
{cartItems.map((item) => ( ))}
Product Price Quantity Subtotal
{item.product?.name} {item.product?.portionSize || '1 portion'}
${Number(item.price).toFixed(2)}
Max {Math.min(item.availableQuantity, item.maxOrder)} 		${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}
{/* Checkout & Fulfillment Sidebar */}
Fulfillment Method
setFulfillmentType('PICKUP')} />
{cartBatch.deliveryAvailable ? (
setFulfillmentType('DELIVERY')} />
) : ( Delivery is not offered for this batch. )}
Order Summary
Items Subtotal: ${cartSubtotal.toFixed(2)}
Delivery Fee: ${deliveryFee.toFixed(2)}
Estimated Total: ${totalAmount.toFixed(2)}
); }; export default Cart;
